notes:
Snapshot from AE/SE calls + workshop notes. Short, CRM style.

Background: Latent Loop builds an enterprise-grade knowledge layer for mid-market SaaS apps (search + personalization). Product team evaluating LLM to replace current elastic ranking + hybrid heuristics.

Discovery highlights:
- Desired workloads: document search embeddings + reranking for top-k, plus a lightweight user-facing chat for troubleshooting. Heavy embedding generation during nightly indexing; realtime rerank on query path.
- SLA targets: p99 latency ~120ms for rerank + chat soft SLO 300-500ms, embeddings batch jobs tolerant up to 10s.
- Cost sensitivity: unit economics are tight. CFO asked for dedicated pricing scenarios if cost/unit drops 30% vs hosted at scale.
- Model preferences: fine with open models (Llama-derived) but wants Redwood-verified throughput profiles; will consider quantized variants.

Evaluation / POC timeline so far:
- 2026-01-19: Intro demo (hosted API) with Jordan. Fireflies: ff-20260123-LLT-demo. Notes: liked streaming + function-call examples.
- 2026-02-02: POC kickoff - embeddings indexing sample set (200k docs). SE (Priya) provided quickstart + ingestion template.
- 2026-02-19: Cost optimization workshop (remote, 2 hours). Fireflies: ff-20260219-cost-workshop. Focus: batching, prefix/KV caching for chat, quantization tradeoffs.
- 2026-02-28: Security sync with infra team; provided SOC2 doc and SAML mapping template. Gmail thread: thread-CAu9x2x_LLT-security-esc.
- 2026-03-04: POC mid-review: rerank latency within target on hosted small burst; embedding nightly job cost higher than expected. Action: run batching/quantization experiment on dedicated SKU.

Workshop outcomes (from SE notes):
- Suggested config: embed batching of 256 items per batch for nightly jobs (expected 3x throughput improvement).
- KV cache + prefix caching for common query prefixes reduced rerank CPU by estimated 40% in sim. Expect ~20-30% per-token cost reduction for chat/rerank when enabling cache + intelligent routing to smaller model variants for less-latent traffic.
- Quantization profile recommendations: try 4-bit QAT candidate on dedicated GPUs for rerank model; note quality delta on top-10 rerank MRR ~0.5-1% (acceptable to product team).
- Redwood Optimize run suggested unit economics scenarios: hosted (baseline) vs. dedicated standard vs. dedicated w/ optimized quant+cache. Best-case ARR uplift by moving to dedicated assumed ~1.8x margin improvement.

Quotes / customer color:
- "If we can get per-embedding cost to under $0.0008 with nightly throughput, we'll be able to flip this into a customer feature" — Head of Product.
- Infra lead: "Need explicit audit logs and KMS integration before dedicated procurement."

Open items / blockers to address in next week:
- Provide concrete dedicated pricing worksheet (per-token + fixed capacity) and three run-rate scenarios (12/24/36 months). Drive doc: latent-loop-pricing-deck-v2.
- SE to run quantization A/B on reserved GPU pool and report quality metrics on rerank set (Jira INF-1423).
- Security: finalize SAML metadata exchange; schedule SSO test (thread-CAu9x2x_LLT-security-esc).

Immediate next steps (AE/SE):
- 2026-03-12: 60-min follow-up to review quantified cost scenarios and show dedicated raw throughput numbers (Priya/Jordan).
- 2026-03-18: deliver pricing worksheet and suggested capacity commit tiers.
- Close signals: confirm CFO ok with committed ARR and security sign-off.

Other notes:
- Potential upsell: Redwood Console retention + Optimize seat for ongoing unit-econ monitoring.
- Competitive note: customer running parallel eval with OpenAI + Anthropic; primary decision driver is predictable unit economics and SSO/SOC2 compliance.
